title: 5-Day Zagora Desert Escape from Marrakech
metaDescription: Travel from Marrakech to Zagora through Ait Ben Haddou and Ouarzazate on a five-day southern Morocco journey featuring kasbahs, valleys and desert scenery.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
summary:
The 5-Day Morocco Tour leaves Marrakech for an overland journey through the High Atlas and the desert landscapes of southern Morocco. Travel toward Zagora before continuing to Erg Lihoudi, where an overnight desert camp brings a different setting to the route. The return journey passes through Ouarzazate and Ait Ben Haddou, linking desert scenery with the region’s traditional earthen architecture and fortified settlements.
Accommodation is split between selected hotels and a desert camp, with longer distances covered by private road transportation. Breakfast and dinner are provided as specified, together with local guides, airport transfers, entrance fees and scheduled sightseeing during the five-day journey.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Marrakech
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Marrakech Menara Airport and Transfer to your hotel in Marrakech.
Hotel check-in after 14:00pm. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Marrakech.

itinerary.title: Marrakech - Zagora - Erg Lihoudi (450km)
itinerary.text:
Departure by A/C 4x4 vehicle to Zagora, passing through Ouarzazate and Agdz. Optional lunch en route. Drive through the scenic Draa Valley with its palm groves and Saharan oasis landscapes. Continue to Mhamid El Ghizlane and proceed to Erg Lihoudi. Dinner.
Overnight in a traditional Berber desert camp (tent).

itinerary.title: Erg Lihoudi - Lac Iriki - Foum Zguid - Ouarzazate (290 km)
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the desert bivouac in Erg Lihoudi. Drive off-road through the desert landscapes of Lake Iriki toward Foum Zguid, with the chance to see a traditional camel caravan in the desert. Optional lunch en route. Continue to Ouarzazate, known for its film studios and Kasbahs. Overnight in Ouarzazate.

itinerary.title: Ouarzazate - Ait Ben Haddou - Marrakech (225km)
itinerary.text: Visit Aït Benhaddou, a UNESCO World Heritage Kasbah featured in many international films. Continue to Marrakech, known as the “Pearl of the South.” Enjoy an afternoon city tour of Marrakech. Optional dinner with traditional show. Overnight in Marrakech.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 5-Day Morocco Trip?
faqs.a: The 5-Day Morocco Trip covers Marrakech, Zagora, Ait Ben Haddou, and Ouarzazate. This exciting itinerary takes travelers through the High Atlas Mountains, ancient kasbahs, desert landscapes, and traditional Berber villages, offering an unforgettable taste of southern Morocco. The tour runs for 4 nights and 5 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 5-Day Morocco Trip cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €995 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, private land transportation, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, and transfers according to the itinerary. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and accommodation category.

faqs.q: Is transportation included throughout the tour?
faqs.a: Yes, private land transportation is included throughout the entire journey. Comfortable vehicles are used for transfers and sightseeing, allowing travelers to enjoy Morocco's spectacular mountain and desert scenery.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels, traditional riads, and desert-area lodgings with daily breakfast. Properties are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and authentic Moroccan atmosphere.

faqs.q: Does the tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guide will share fascinating insights into Morocco's history, culture, architecture, and local traditions throughout the trip.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Morocco?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for travelers who want to experience Morocco's desert landscapes and southern cultural highlights within a short timeframe. It provides a wonderful introduction to the country's diverse scenery and heritage.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through kasbahs, historic villages, desert areas, and uneven terrain. Most visitors with average fitness levels can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Marrakech, Zagora, Ait Ben Haddou, and Ouarzazate?
faqs.a: Marrakech is famous for its colorful souks, historic palaces, and lively Jemaa el-Fnaa Square. Zagora offers beautiful desert scenery and serves as a gateway to the Sahara region. Ait Ben Haddou is a UNESCO World Heritage Site renowned for its impressive fortified village and film locations. Ouarzazate is known as the "Gateway to the Desert" and is famous for its kasbahs, cinematic landscapes, and movie studios.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 5-Day Morocco Trip?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the 5-Day Morocco Trip be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade accommodations, include luxury desert camp experiences, extend your stay in Marrakech, or modify the itinerary to suit your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
